entries.title: Nioh
entries.definitive_edition: Nioh Remastered: Complete Edition on PlayStation 5

emulation.notes: Capture the PS5 remaster directly; use PC Complete Edition only if PS5 capture is impractical.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PS5 remaster with all DLC and 120 FPS support.

primary.why: The PlayStation 5 Remastered Complete Edition is the best route because it includes the base game and all three DLC expansions while offering 120 FPS support; the PC Complete Edition is capped at 60 FPS.
primary.how_to_play: Play Nioh Remastered: Complete Edition on PS5 through The Nioh Collection or the standalone remaster. Use 120 FPS mode if your capture setup supports it.

all_releases.fidelity: Original console release with DLC sold separately.
Complete PC release with all three DLC expansions but a 60 FPS cap.
all_releases.reason: skip: complete route, but PS5 Remastered Complete has the higher sourced frame-rate ceiling.

all_releases.fidelity: Complete remaster with all DLC, PS5 enhancement, ultra-fast loading, and 120 FPS support.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest-fidelity complete route for the first Nioh.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Windows PC is easier for capture/mod-style setup, but the PS5 Remastered Complete Edition has the higher sourced frame-rate ceiling while remaining complete.

entries.remaster_caveats: Use a complete edition; the base PS4 release alone does not include the DLC expansions.

entries.title: Nioh 2
entries.definitive_edition: Nioh 2: The Complete Edition on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the PC Complete Edition for capture and settings control.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Complete PC presentation with all DLC.

primary.why: The Windows PC Complete Edition is the best route because it includes all three DLC expansions and supports the full PC capture/settings path. The PS5 Remastered Complete Edition is also complete, but it does not add sourced exclusive content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Nioh 2: The Complete Edition on Steam and play the Windows PC build with all DLC installed.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PS4 release before Complete/Remastered editions.
all_releases.reason: skip: superseded by complete/remastered routes that include all DLC.

all_releases.fidelity: Complete PC release with all previous DLC and PC capture/settings flexibility.
Nioh 2 Remastered: Complete Edition for PS5 with all previous DLC.
all_releases.reason: skip: excellent complete console route, but no sourced exclusive content over Windows PC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The complete DLC set is available on the Windows PC primary route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Use a Complete Edition route; base PS4 alone is not the complete DLC path.

entries.title: Nioh 3

emulation.notes: Use the current PC release and latest patches.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with settings control.

primary.why: The Windows PC release is the best route because Nioh 3 launched simultaneously on PC and PS5, and the PC version gives the best capture/settings flexibility for the current game.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Nioh 3 on Steam and play the Windows PC build; check compatibility guidance and current patch notes before a long capture run.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with capture/settings flexibility.
all_releases.reason: primary: best capture/settings route for the current entry.
skip: same game content, with no sourced exclusive content over Windows PC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No platform-exclusive content route is documented.

entries.remaster_caveats: No complete/remastered edition is documented yet; revisit if DLC or an expanded edition is announced.
